name: Codex CLI
what: OpenAI's terminal coding agent; its config.toml can name local model providers with a base_url, which is how it reaches a resident model.

all: In ~/.codex/config.toml add a [model_providers.local] with base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1" and point a profile at it.

good: agentic coding against a local OpenAI-style server
not: a model server of its own
